It is completely understandable that your partner's invasive behaviors are triggering, especially when you are already carrying past trauma. You deserve to feel trusted, respected, and safe in your relationship, and having your phone checked or being repeatedly accused of cheating can be deeply exhausting. 

When deciding between individual and couples counseling, many professionals recommend starting with individual therapy. An individual counselor can provide a safe, dedicated space just for you to process your trauma, manage your triggers, and establish healthy boundaries regarding your partner's behavior. While couples counseling can be valuable for addressing trust and communication issues, it requires both partners to be fully willing to take accountability and work on the relationship. Prioritizing your own healing first through individual therapy can give you the clarity, support, and emotional bandwidth to decide the best next steps for yourself and your relationship.
